proposed_capability: Make the existing decline-only port callable inside the verified installed player runtime, including when a native trait dialog pauses the game.
player_save_control_impact: Only an exact-build explicitly enabled adapter can submit. No desktop input, pause write, save write or unknown consent accepted.
expected_outcome: The self-contained installed package imports and uses the existing decline-only response policy, with two fresh trusted probes, matching exact run and pause state, and independent readback. Legacy host interface and bundle variants still work.
negative_tests: Paused queue remains untouched; player takeover interrupts modal dispatch.
Missing binding proof or unverified negative response never sends.
A stale or unrelated modal frame cannot dispatch or report proof.
Isolated archive launches without host checkout or desktop dependencies.
rollback_path: Revert the feature and use the prior installed player runtime or legacy archive. Keep local learning data and active game state.
unresolved_unknowns: Installed Windows game callback, exact local EA source and live outcome.
decision_rationale: Independently reproduced omitted package dependencies and missing modal lifecycle. Bridge existing owners without inventing EA signatures.
